seed_registry_check: no exact matches in formal_seed_registry.json at preparation; must recheck at freeze

tracks_A_B.duplicate_A_B_cells: execute once, reference under both control views; not extra independent replication
tracks_A_B.transformer_training: parallel teacher-forced chunk with detached previous-layer KV across TBPTT boundaries; no inference-only cached() training call; validate separately before freeze

track_C.budget_proposal: measured/validated cumulative complete-update C1 budget corresponding to 250K prediction events
track_C.last_update_policy: count full accepted update, record undershoot/overshoot; reject completion if outside 5%; never silently change target

track_D.memory_scope: all per-session tensor storage, retained token buffers, counters and explicit metadata; weights shared and reported separately; no padding to manufacture matching
track_D.cellular_fixed_state: 8192 tensor bytes plus per-session metadata; no state truncation without separate architecture/protocol
track_D.transformer_budgets: derive maximum retained KV length from actual storage plus metadata; changing inference window is an explicit intervention
track_D.query_rule: fixed answer-token sequence and exact match; same randomized entities/queries across models; no model-dependent prompt tuning

statistics.secondary: C1-BROADCAST versus T1-PM-KV under each distinct controlled track
statistics.paired_unit: unique document ID and equal target token count
statistics.reviewer_agreement: ordinal weighted kappa with sample/model/mode coverage; specify handling before scoring

runtime_plan.interpretation: 12 isolated jobs times two-hour allocation cap, not measured training cost; C/D and Pilot excluded

freeze_gates: complete data/Tokenizer identity from pinned verified source
accepted-update exposure ledger must be checkpoint-atomic with sampler/optimizer
validate complete forward/backward/clipping/optimizer arithmetic coverage in target runtime
choose numerical Compute-Matched budget and checkpoint targets
measure optimized training throughput in separately authorized Pilot before estimating actual GPU hours
